phases.name: The Second Form
phases.say: You thought that was my body? That was my patience.

say.open: The lord of the Pit sets down his cup. Guests. How long it has been since anything came this deep alive.
say.death: Then let the Pit choose another.

bestiary.lore: The Pit's true lord, who let the Dark General think he ruled. Three bodies, each worn inside the last.
bestiary.weakness: Holy, and Water a little. Every form change strips the party's buffs: hold the big ones until the last form.
bestiary.pattern: A swordsman who bolts the weakest Scion and scorns a whole row. Beaten down, he sheds the body and rises larger, twice, and each time every buff on the party is torn away.
